purpose: Give future Astra/Codex research one leakage-aware map of the already recovered MAEVE evidence, permanently preserved private CFGI and market-context authorities, repo-native CFGI materializations, provider-availability metadata, genuine gaps, and preferred multi-timeframe research ladder without copying restricted provider values into the public control plane.
private_binding_policy: Restricted values remain in Donh91/secrets. Public inventory exposes only immutable commit/path/hash/coverage metadata required for agent routing and provenance.

caveats: Exact raw and normalized values remain private.
cfgi_score_entry is currently the cleanest recovered entry-time CFGI field.
analisis_hora and recovered impulse/volatility/volume sub-score columns are look-ahead suspect until timestamp semantics are resolved.
DCA-adjusted position success must not be equated with first-entry signal accuracy.
The recovery does not establish the proprietary algorithm itself.

15m.use: Study MAEVE timing, feature velocity, short-sequence persistence, cross-timeframe transitions, and entry/DCA microstructure. Native 15m must remain distinct from ~15m observations of 4h/1d state.

1h.use: Primary candidate for action-clock modeling, matched controls, chronological OOS, and later frozen paper simulation.

2h.use: If useful, derive only from CLOSED 1h observations using time-valid transforms. Never use future-containing resampling bins.

4h.use: Lower-noise action/confirmation candidate with immutable historical bootstrap and forward cold-raw lanes.

1d.use: Regime, risk-budget and trend-context layer rather than default trade clock.

genuine_gaps_not_yet_proven_filled: A complete locally materialized multi-year CFGI history across all native 15m/1h/4h/1d timeframes is not yet proven and should not be bulk-backfilled without a research need.
The mapping between the described ten public MAEVE/CFGI algorithm families and the currently observed aggregate plus component fields is not proven. Do not equate them silently.
Native 2h provider history is not proven; 2h remains derived-only unless independently evidenced.
Individual historical CFGI coverage for MAEVE-traded SOL/DOGE/BNB and other assets is not proven; the 851882-row hourly market panel supplies market context, not individual CFGI.
Recovered MAEVE component-field timestamps require leakage adjudication before entry-feature use.

Legacy repo paths may contain duplicates or superseded derivatives not exhaustively enumerated here; this does not justify new data collection unless an actual research question exposes a missing cell.
closed_non_gaps: The two GitHub Actions artifacts expiring on 2026-09-20 are already preserved permanently in Donh91/secrets with immutable hashes; they must not be recopied merely because the temporary artifact remains reachable.
Historical MARKET for the two frozen 2025 event windows is provider-unavailable and NOT_TESTABLE after a terminal zero-row result. No additional paid retry is authorized.
High-frequency approximately 15m observations of 4h/1d CFGI state already exist in the private PDLT bootstrap; this is useful but is not native 15m CFGI.

next_actions.action: Use the permanent MAEVE ledger, private 1h CFGI event stage, private 4h/1d PDLT bootstrap, and private 851882-row hourly market panel as the starting research stack before requesting any new provider history.
For Astra research, join only event-time-valid observations, preserve version boundaries, use matched no-trade controls, and keep DCA capital accounting explicit.
Compare native single-timeframe 1h and 4h models first, then hierarchical multi-timeframe fusion using native 15m only if a documented research need requires it and 1d as regime context.
Only after a concrete experiment identifies a missing symbol/timeframe/time-range cell, test the CFGI API for that smallest necessary gap. Do not reopen terminal MARKET frozen-window retries.
Artifact-retention safety is handled separately by public issue #855, which must rescue any other high-value expiring temporary artifacts to permanent private authorities before expiry.
